user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Enter your Immich server details. Home Assistant will verify the connection before continuing.

source.title: Choose a photo source
source.description: Choose how this frame should select photos.

connection.title: Choose an Immich connection
connection.description: Reuse a saved server and API key, or connect to another server. The connection will be checked before continuing.

data_description.connection_id: Saved connections show the server URL and the name of a frame that uses it.

new_connection.title: Connect to another Immich server
new_connection.description: Enter the server URL and API key. These details will be available when you add more frames.

smart.title: Configure Keywords
smart.description: Enter keywords describing the photos you want to find.

data_description.smart_query: Enter a description such as “beach at sunset”.

display.title: Set up the frame
display.description: Name your frame, then save. Display settings are available on the frame’s device page.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Immich
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new read-only API key for this frame’s Immich server. Your frame settings and entity identities will be kept.

error.connection_unavailable: That saved connection is no longer available. Choose another connection or enter the server details again.
error.invalid_auth: Check the API key and its asset.read permission in Immich.
error.smart_query_required: Enter keywords describing the photos you want to find.
error.album_access_denied: Could not access albums. Check that your Immich API key is valid and has album.read permission, then choose Albums to retry.
error.albums_unavailable: Could not load albums from Immich. Choose Albums to retry, or select another photo source.
error.no_albums: No albums are available to this Immich account. Create or share an album in Immich, then choose Albums to retry, or select All photos.
error.album_unavailable: One or more selected albums are no longer available. Check the updated list and select the albums to use.
error.album_required: Choose at least one album to continue.
error.name_required: Enter a name for this frame.
error.name_in_use: Another frame on this server already uses this name. Choose a different name.

abort.already_configured: A frame with this name is already configured.
